name: Voxel optimization (F2Plenoxels)
aliases: Depth-guided voxel pre-pruning with SH regularization
definition: An optimization algorithm for voxel radiance fields that uses depth-guided voxel pre-pruning, spherical harmonics regularization, and gradient scaling to improve few-shot view synthesis quality without neural networks.
summary: F2Plenoxels is a neural-network-free voxel radiance field method for few-shot view synthesis that uses depth-guided pre-pruning and SH regularization to reduce artifacts while maintaining high geometry accuracy.
